plain: A former Air Force security guard at a nuclear missile site, Mario Woods, says that during an abduction in South Dakota he was met by several small beings and a taller one behind them. He tells Michels firsthand that they looked like Grays, the small grey-skinned beings of abduction stories, "but the one behind them I guess you would classify him as a tall gray", like the one in Whitley Strieber's book Communion. He dates the abduction to 1977, though the story is sometimes placed in the 1960s. If true, it would mean beings were taking people near nuclear sites, with a clear leader among them. The researcher Robert Hastings recorded a similar account in an article published in 2017, about a former Air Force missile security policeman's apparent abduction. In it, Woods says: "I think I remember small figures, maybe five or six, walking toward the vehicle. Standing behind them was a taller figure who I think was in charge."
